description: Around 9 PM this evening, both AP and the Washington Post called the results for the redistricting referendum, declaring "Yes" the winner, thereby allowing the proposed map to be implemented by the legislature. As I noted in a letter to the editor on Friday, this is a highly partisan, extremely gerrymandered map - one I would never vote for under normal circumstances.But these are not normal circumstances.
